input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only provision giving Vendor verification rights over our usage (no other inspection, monitoring or remote-access language exists). It meets the preferred position on every material term: frequency limited to once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1); Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and Vendor and its auditor are expressly barred from direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information (22.2). Section 22.3 further protects us by treating findings as Customer Confidential Information and requiring delivery of the final report. No redline needed.
